content: Mojibake (Bulgarian: maymunitsa) results from encoding mismatches: UTF-8 bytes decoded as Windows-1252/CP1251, missing charset meta tag forcing browser guess, or UTF-8 data written into a Latin-1 database losing Cyrillic bytes. CP1251 was the dominant pre-Unicode Cyrillic encoding for Bulgarian; ensure consistent UTF-8 declared in HTTP header, HTML meta, file encoding, and DB/table collation.
